title: Stephan 2026: superlinear complexity of the (3/2)^n steering word
summary: A minimal Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of R. Stephan, Superlinear complexity of the (3/2)^n steering word (arXiv:2607.11648), built on the repository's libraries ArithmeticHeights and DiophantineApproximation, whose p-adic Subspace Theorem it uses. Write (3/2)^n = m_n + ε_n with m_n the nearest integer and t_n = 2 m_{n+1} − 3 m_n. The library Stephan2026a is sorry-free and within Lean's three standard axioms.
